Message:

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
build(Rest): Regenerate binary for latest release

Rebuild the `Rest` binary artifact following the previous documentation overhaul and telemetry integration. This ensures the compiled executable at `bin/Rest` matches the current state of the `Source/Main.rs` entry point and Rust dependencies.

The binary is responsible for bundling VS Code platform code via OXC for consumption by the Cocoon extension host and Sky UI layer. No source code changes were made; this is a necessary rebuild to synchronize the artifact with the updated project configuration.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Rest): Integrate telemetry initialization and refactor shell scripts

Add shared dual-pipe telemetry initialization (PostHog + OTLP) to the Rest binary entry point (`Source/Main.rs`) via the `Common` library dependency, enabling tiered observability for the bundler while maintaining a no-op default in release builds.

Refactor `Bench.sh`, `prepublishOnly.sh`, and `run_tests.sh` to enforce strict POSIX-compliant formatting. This includes standardizing redirection spacing (`> /dev/null`), normalizing quote styles, and aligning pipe operators to match the project's shell scripting standards.

Update `CHANGELOG.md` with comprehensive v2.1 documentation detailing the OXC 0.127 migration, binary entry point separation, and PascalCase compliance. Additionally, restructure `tests/lib.rs` into explicit `integration` and `unit` namespaces for clearer test organization, and reformat `Source/Fn/OXC/Codegen.rs` for improved readability.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
docs(Rest): overhaul CHANGELOG with Keep-a-Changelog format

Complete rewrite of the CHANGELOG to align with Keep-a-Changelog conventions and provide richer narrative around Rest's evolution. Rest is the JS bundler that compiles VS Code platform source into bundled trees loaded by Cocoon and Sky.

Reorganized content across all versions (v2.1 back to v0.0), added commit SHAs with dates for key milestones, expanded the OXC migration documentation (the pivotal v2.0 change from March 2026), and added a new "Fixed" section documenting the January 2026 stability sweep. The CHANGELOG now clearly tells Rest's story from SWC origins through the OXC pivot to the current full-workbench state.

Version headings simplified from "Q2 2026: Full Workbench Lift" to "Full Workbench Lift (April 2026)" for clarity.

Message:

This establishes the correct binary structure for the Rest bundler component.
